title: Bram and the Hollow Revisited
author: Sebastian Quintana
blurb: Ivo Underhill, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
